## About
Land-N-Lawns is a full service, hands on landscape company. It started while we were in college, mowing and maintaining residential lawns, and that work led us into landscaping, turf installation and tree services.
Our goal is to keep the value of your landscape through proper care and sustainable enhancements, with competitive pricing. Matt and the crew work on everything from a single backyard makeover to commercial properties, and we keep expanding into new developing areas in and around San Antonio.

## Services
- Lawn maintenance and mowing: Regular lawn care for homes and commercial properties.
- Landscaping and turf installation: Full yard makeovers, from tilling and topsoil to new grass, flagstone walkways, edging and plants.
- Soil, mulch, rock and sand: Delivery and installation of landscape materials, including river rock laid over landscape fabric to keep weeds down.
- Tree services: Trimming, shaping, directional and detail pruning, ball moss removal, roof clearance, thinning, hauling away and tree installation.
- Tree and stump removal: Tree and stump removals, with the yard left as clean as we found it.
- Irrigation work: One reviewer called on the crew for emergency irrigation work on his lawn.

## FAQ
Q: What days are you available?
A: We are available every day of the week, weekends included.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. Along with residential communities, we work on commercial offices, shopping centers, hotels, banks, churches, new developments and real estate properties, and we carry the insurance required by large property management companies and local government agencies.

Q: Can you help a home listing with curb appeal?
A: A real estate reviewer called us when a new listing needed curb appeal and said both she and her client were happy with the work.
